I went to the Greenhead Thai Traditional Clinic in Kamala for a Tok Sen massage (therapeutic tapping massage) and I'm truly impressed.

I've had significant spinal curvature for years due to Scheuermann's disease – after the first treatment, my spine was measurably straightened by about 2 cm. The team worked with genuine expertise, not just offering wellness treatments, but targeted manual therapy.

The combination of Tok Sen, fascia work, and traditional Thai medicine was extremely effective. Measurements were taken before and after the treatment using a ruler, and the result was clearly visible and noticeable.

I felt professionally cared for and treated with great respect the entire time.

Anyone in Phuket looking for genuine, top-quality therapeutic Thai massage (not just "beach pampering") should definitely go here.

🙏 Highly recommended – this was one of the best treatments of my life.
